title: An Unclear Neuron
headline: A calibration neuron the tool should not call clean, and does not. Layer 22, neuron 11024 of 1-bit Bonsai-8B fires on scattered clause endings. Label-driven text rarely makes it fire, its opposite pole never fires strongly on its label, and pushing it changes the model's output incoherently.
summary: Forward: a blind agent's best label from corpus examples ('the payoff token of a stated outcome') predicted the bank poorly. Only 15% of on-label sentences fired strongly, and 11 were silent.

Refinement and held-out: a second agent, seeing the bank results, narrowed it to 'the closing amount of a hypothetical change'. That ranks new sentences well (AUROC 0.92), but only 4 of 12 predicted-fire sentences actually fired. All four are hypothetical money outcomes ('would have roughly $200,000').
Opposite pole: no sentence written for its label fired strongly (0%).

Induce: no coherent theme in either direction ('relief', 'glad' vs 'on', 'still', 'calm'), and about 6× weaker effect on the model than the genre neuron. globalMOO missed its 50% and 75% targets, consistent with a neuron that has no smooth response to label-driven text.
offshoots: hypothetical money outcomes ('would have close to N3,000') reach 0.4–1.0
